lines.en: label chinamigenafternoon:
I tap on Chinami's name and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点开 Chinami 的名字，等她接电话。

lines.en: : Hello! Thank you for calling the Chinami hotline! How may she be of service?
lines.zh: : 你好！感谢致电 Chinami 热线！请问需要她做什么？

lines.en: scene black
I talk with Chinami for a few minutes before finding out that she's alone.
lines.zh: 我和 Chinami 聊了几分钟，才知道她一个人在家。

lines.en: Apparently, Yumi was supposed to stop by but never did.
lines.zh: 本来 Yumi 说要过来的，但一直没来。

lines.en: Not wanting to leave her alone, I decide to head over myself...
lines.zh: 我不想把她一个人扔着，于是决定自己过去……

lines.en: scene chinamiafternoongen
When I show up at the apartment, Chinami is in the middle of watching some gameshow on television.
lines.zh: 我到公寓的时候，Chinami 正在看电视上的某个游戏节目。

lines.en: But despite hearing her cheers from the front door, she turns the TV off and decides to focus her attention on me instead.
lines.zh: 但尽管我在门口就听见她在欢呼，她还是把电视关了，决定把注意力放在我身上。

lines.en: Sure, it feels a little weird being alone with her in the middle of the afternoon while her sister is unaware, but I shrug it off when I realize that both of them trust me.
lines.zh: 当然，大白天和她独处、而她姐姐还不知道，感觉是有点奇怪，但想到她们俩都信得过我，我也就不再多想。

lines.en: {i}Why{/i} they trust me, I can't really say. But as long as it keeps providing me opportunities like this, I'm not going to complain.
lines.zh: 她们{i}为什么{/i}信我，我说不上来。但只要这还能给我这样的机会，我就不会抱怨。

lines.en: scene black
It gets dark rather quickly and I decide to be a good person and order Chinami a pizza before I leave.
lines.zh: 天很快就黑了，我决定做个好人，走之前给 Chinami 点了份披萨。

lines.en: She thanks me and hugs my legs, telling me that if I ever decide to marry her sister that she will support it wholeheartedly.
lines.zh: 她道了谢，抱住我的腿，说如果我哪天决定娶她姐姐，她会全心全意支持。

lines.en: It is a strange way to say goodbye, but it's one that I have grown to accept.
lines.zh: 这种告别方式有点奇怪，但我已经慢慢习惯了。

lines.en: Unfortunately for her, I don't plan on marrying anyone any time soon...
lines.zh: 不过对她来说不幸的是，我近期没打算娶任何人……

lines.en: $ chinami_love += 1
{i}Chinami's affection has increased to [chinami_love]!{/i}
jump saturdaynight
